why: Re-measured the 8 rows the 2026-09-22 feed pass put in failed_domain_check. Three were real (Botswana Guardian is a genuine hijack, The Santiago Times' feed stops in 2023, The Texan's returns 0 items). The rest were two rebrands, two faults in our own heuristics, and one 429.

held_detail.St. Louis Post-Dispatch: HTTP 429 on two attempts. Lee Enterprises rate-limits this runner's IP. NOT unmeasured: one earlier fetch in the same session, with the corrected tooling, returned 50 items, 50 on stltoday.com and 50 article-shaped, title 'www.stltoday.com - RSS Results of type article with keyword(s) of #topstory'. That is one observation, not two, so the row is held rather than applied. Re-run from an unthrottled IP.
held_detail.Rapid City Journal: HTTP 429 on two attempts, same host and same rate limit. Never successfully measured. Re-run from an unthrottled IP.

stays_rejected.Botswana Guardian: A genuine hijack and the reason the expected-domain check exists. Its feed resolves to bettingbotswana.com, titles itself 'Betting Botswana', and its sample link is a football betting page.
stays_rejected.The Santiago Times: Not hijacked, abandoned. The feed is on santiagotimes.com where the roster has .cl, and its newest item is dated 2023.
